state.misconception_label: Confuses rest and movement on a distance time graph

turn_history.speaker: student
turn_history.text: I have: This graph shows how far Fido the dog is from his home. I got Fido has fallen asleep because I'm not sure I worked it out the right way.

turn_history.speaker: teacher
turn_history.text: Let's review the misconception of confusing rest and movement on a distance-time graph. Remember, a horizontal line doesn't necessarily mean zero distance traveled. Can you explain why you think Fido has fallen asleep based on the graph?

turn_history.text: Turn 3 (teacher): It's great that you're questioning your initial interpretation.
